groups.description: 57 eyes of 43 patients (11-28 years) with progressive keratoconus treated with standard epithelium-off (Dresden) cross-linking, 3.0 mW/cm2 for 30 min (Methods, Results)

series.notes: mean ± SD; Pentacam HR (Methods); all 57 eyes measured before and 12 months after cross-linking

notes: Age group mixed: 11-28 years, 19 patients younger than 18 and 24 older than 18 (Results).
Both eyes of some patients are included (57 eyes of 43 patients); hypotonic riboflavin was needed in 6 eyes.
Thinnest pachymetry, ARC, PRC, ABCD grades, ARTmax and elevations (Table 2) are tabulated and not used.
